content.value: To defog the rare window of an automobile, a very thin transparent heating element is attached to the inner surface of the window. A uniform heat flux of 1300 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 }$ is provided to the heating element for defogging a rear window with thickness of 5 mm. The interior temperature of the automobile is $2 2 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and convection heat transfer coefficient is 15 $\mathrm { w } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 } . \dot { \mathrm { K } } .$ The outside ambient temperature $\mathrm { i } s - 5 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { C }$ and convection heat transfer coefficient is 100 $\mathrm { W } / \mathrm { m } ^ { 2 } . \mathrm { K } .$ If the thermal conductivity of the window is $1 . 2 ~ \mathrm { W / m } . \mathrm { K } .$ determine the inner surface temperature of the window.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2021
